headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: EBITDA stood at INR 20.3 crore, with margins contracting to 3.5% from 4.1% in Q2FY26, while PAT increased to INR 14.9 crore.
Profitability remained impacted by initial operating expenses and underutilisation at the new facility, despite improving production volumes.
Management highlighted that consolidated EBITDA per kg improved to approximately INR 59 in H1FY27 from INR 44 last year.
Management expects remaining capacity installation around December–January.
valuation: CTC trial production is targeted for mid-December, with commercial contribution beginning in Q4FY27.
Valuation call – At CMP of INR 73.7, we recommend BUY for Vidya Wires with a price target of INR 92.2 (16.9X FY29 Earnings), representing an upside of 25.1%.
watch: Capacity expansion remains the key operational focus, with approximately 10,000–11,000 MT installed at LQ against the planned 18,000 TPA.
Key operational challenges include commissioning delays, customer approval timelines, and copper price volatility.
